  • Method Details

    • parseAuthorizationToJwtDataSet

      public static Optional<JwtDataSet> parseAuthorizationToJwtDataSet(String authenticationHeader, JwtExtractorProperties jwtExtractorProperties)
      Reads what the audit record is to say about the access token the request carried.

      A token that cannot be looked into is not the same as no token at all: it yields JwtDataSet.opaque(), so that the record can state that a token was presented even though its contents were not visible here. Only a request without a bearer token yields nothing.

      Parameters:
      authenticationHeader - contents of the Authorization header, may be null
      jwtExtractorProperties - where to find the claims
      Returns:
      the claims, an opaque marker, or empty if the request carried no bearer token

    • parseAuthenticationToJWT

      public static Optional<com.nimbusds.jwt.JWT> parseAuthenticationToJWT(String authenticationHeader)
      Parameters:
      authenticationHeader - contents of the Authorization header, may be null
      Returns:
      the token as a JWT whose claims can be read, or empty when it is not one. An encrypted JWT counts as not one: it parses, but its claims stay sealed without the key, which the audit source does not have -- so it is as opaque here as a reference token.
